subject.title: Apply design-system composer to app chat UI

question: Should the composer redesign, shared FunctionalUI flyout changes, and new persisted Chat settings land as one coordinated UX change, or should the Settings/config work be split from the composer restyle?
rationale: The branch introduces a new user-facing design and configuration surface across multiple ownership seams, while repository guidance favors one reviewable seam per PR and no maintainer has confirmed the combined direction.

options.title: Split settings from composer
options.body: Keep the composer and its required flyout primitives together, then move persisted Chat settings into a separate focused PR with independent proof.

options.title: Sponsor the combined UX
options.body: Explicitly accept the coordinated composer-plus-Settings direction and require the localization blocker to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Narrow to composer only
options.body: Drop the new persisted settings and retain existing control placement while landing only the visual composer redesign.

recommendation.title: Split settings from composer
recommendation.body: Keep the composer and its required flyout primitives together, then move persisted Chat settings into a separate focused PR with independent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-cutting WinUI product-scope choice needs repository-level direction rather than a mechanical code repair.
